title: Intel B60 · llama.cpp V4
source: Reconstructed from the B60 evidence campaign B60_matrix_v4_20261104_201559_715039 (profile.json, summary.csv). Not a verbatim terminal capture; batch 4096 (before the batch-1024 decision).

runner.where: ~/b60_benchmark on the B60 machine (copy in Buffer/Benchmark)
runner.note: B60 has been returned to the vendor; this run cannot be repeated.

metrics.aggregate: sum actual output tokens/(last stream_done-first request_start), tokens/s
metrics.normalized: aggregate/NP, tokens/s/user (one concurrent request per user)
metrics.averaging: arithmetic mean of 3 valid repetition wave metrics; failed case metrics null
metrics.streaming: TTFT is first nonempty text SSE arrival; chunks may contain multiple tokens
metrics.cold_warm: resident-model requests, prefix cache OFF; Smoke excluded; NOT process-cold measurements
